items.title: 52035_Eddie Durham oral history interview
items.q: Let me see, it was Lips Page, Walter Page, Buster Smith, Dan Miner... who they never mention, he came from there into Benny Morton's band... I think so. But I know I named the ones that I remember was there. Just like I say, Page and Buster Smith, Lips Page, Dan Miner

ctx.x: So they wanted to know who was going out of the band when they bring somebody else, he's gotta be going to play my note. And that was an argument, say, you're trying to find somebody. I'd say Lips is not going to play anybody's note. He's going to play his own note. And every time they'd play in rehearsal and break for intermission, they all wanted to see Benny, without me. They'd get in a corner, talking -- Benny, the guy's out of his mind, that don't sound right, that chording and all that stuff.
So -- but, now, that's a funny thing. Now when I got ready to put my note in, we had five brass then, see, and I played valve trombone a lot.
